_meta.title: GridWise — Hidden-Like Synthetic Judge Simulator Pack
_meta.event: BUP CSE Fest 2026 · Hackathon · Online Preliminary
_meta.description: 25 fresh synthetic hidden-style cases. NOT copies of public_samples. Each case has 1-3 paraphrased operator notes and a ground-truth interpretation. All scenarios are feasible. End-exclusive hour windows. Solar reduction factor is the fraction remaining.

operator_notes: Rooftop panels at Hall A will drop to one-fifth of forecast from one o'clock in the afternoon to four o'clock in the afternoon because of dust suppression spraying.
From 6 PM until 9 PM tonight, keep at least sixty percent of the battery capacity reserved for emergency lighting in the dormitories.
Tomorrow's cafeteria menu change is purely informational and does not affect today's dispatch.
The relay on the charging line is offline from midnight to four o'clock in the morning; the inverter cannot pull current into the pack.
Substation intake is capped at one hundred and ninety-five kWh per hour from seven in the evening until eleven o'clock at night due to a feeder upgrade.
Reminder: the rooftop PV array will be inspected next Tuesday; no impact on today's dispatch.
Cafeteria chillers will run from six in the evening to eight at night tonight, so keep at least 45% of the pack in reserve across hours 18-19.
Note: chiller swap is scheduled for next Sunday and does not affect today's plan.
During the fire-alarm test the battery cannot supply the halls; do not discharge from five o'clock in the afternoon to seven o'clock at night.
Forecast haze will cut solar by about 25% between ten o'clock in the morning and two o'clock in the afternoon (i.e. usable solar drops to ~75% of forecast).
Transformer 4 intake must remain at or below 200 kWh per hour between six o'clock in the evening and nine o'clock at night due to a load-shedding alert.
Keep at least 130 kWh in the battery from six o'clock in the evening to eight o'clock at night so the auditorium can ride through any grid blip.

Reminder: hostel water heater will be replaced next Wednesday.

Note: HVAC tuning scheduled for next week.
